name: Italian motorway tolls (ESTIMATE: Autostrade per l'Italia's plain-stretch rate per km)
law: Estimate. Italian motorway tolls are each concession's unit rate per km, by vehicle class (A, B by height for two axles; 3, 4, 5 by axles) and by plain or mountain stretch, times the km between toll stations, plus 22% VAT, rounded to 10 cents (the concession agreements with the Ministry, under the State's laws and CIPE resolutions). No station-to-station table can be fetched, so the route's km on toll motorways (OpenStreetMap ways tagged toll=yes) are priced at Autostrade per l'Italia's plain-stretch unit rate, VAT included, in force from 2026-01-01: class B 0.08054, 3 0.10615, 4 0.16108, 5 0.19034 euro per km. Mountain stretches cost about 18% more on ASPI's network (class 5 0.22437), other concessions have their own, mostly higher, rates, and the rounding and fixed-toll stretches aren't modelled, so the true toll can be higher.

sources.title: Autostrade per l'Italia: come si calcola il pedaggio (unit rates per km, VAT included)

vehicles: Vehicles by class: two axles over 1.30 m at the front axle (class B), three, four, five or more axles (classes 3, 4, 5); the tool prices trucks over 3.5 t
tolled_roads: The toll motorways (autostrade a pedaggio) of all concessions, as OpenStreetMap tags them (toll=yes); not the toll-free ones (A2, A19, A29, ring roads) nor the Alpine tunnels, which have their own tables.
